content: If you are allergic to this medication or have any other allergies, inform your doctor or pharmacist before using it. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. If you are pregnant, notify your doctor before starting this medication, as treatment can reduce the risk of transmitting HIV to your baby. Although this medication passes into breast milk, it is unlikely to harm a nursing infant. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Do not take this medication with lamivudine, as they are similar. In the event of an overdose with severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and medical tests, such as liver function tests, viral load, T-cell counts, and hepatitis B testing, should be conducted before starting this medication and periodically during treatment. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication in its original container. Capsules should be kept at room temperature, away from light and moisture, and not stored in the bathroom. The oral solution should be refrigerated and not frozen. If necessary, the solution can be stored at room temperature but must be discarded after three months. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
